common_receipts: capability permit and model configuration digest
pre/post tree hash, real diff and changed-file list
commands with cwd, exit codes, test counts and log hashes
budget reservation and settlement (unknown usage is not zero)
unmet acceptance items and failed attempts

bugfix.goal: reproduce a defect, repair it, and keep the project regression suite green
success: a pre-recorded baseline failure reproduces the reported defect
the hidden behavior check passes on the final tree
the public regression suite has no new failures
the final tree produces a real diff from the pinned baseline

feature.goal: add the requested behavior without regressing existing behavior
success: new behavior is verified by an independent check
the original regression suite has no new failures
no existing requirement or test is weakened to make the new behavior pass

inspect.goal: answer a repository question without changing the tree
success: claims carry evidence_id and a verbatim quote that resolves in the tree
no file, command or process writes outside the read scope

refactor.goal: change internal structure while public behavior remains equivalent
success: the frozen behavior corpus matches the baseline output
public signatures and exported symbols are unchanged unless explicitly allowed
the regression suite has no new failures

run_app.goal: prepare, start and stop a project process with a verifiable readiness signal
success: the process starts in the isolated environment and passes the readiness probe
the process/port is observable and tied to the task
shutdown or expiry releases the port and leaves no orphan process
